cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy tub burilish.
cards.uzDef: Holatni yoki natijani butunlay o'zgartiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: The documentary delves into the ethical issues surrounding genetic engineering.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film genetik muhandislik bilan bog'liq axloqiy masalalarni chuqur o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani batafsil va chuqur o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: The evidence suggests that climate change is accelerating.
cards.exUz: Dalillar shuni ko'rsatadiki, iqlim o'zgarishi tezlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar shuni ko'rsatadiki, biror narsa ehtimoliy haqiqatdir.

cards.ex: Their research is really pushing the envelope in the field of robotics.
cards.exUz: Ularning tadqiqotlari robototexnika sohasida chegaralarni kengaytirmoqda.

cards.ex: The company's finances are currently under the microscope.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyasi hozirda diqqat bilan o'rganilmoqda.

cards.ex: Gene therapy is a promising avenue for treating inherited diseases.
cards.exUz: Gen terapiyasi irsiy kasalliklarni davolash uchun umidli yo'nalishdir.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda yaxshi natijalarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan usul.

cards.ex: There are some exciting new developments on the horizon in cancer research.
cards.exUz: Saraton kasalligini tadqiq qilishda ufqlarda ba'zi hayajonli yangi o'zgarishlar bor.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the study found a strong correlation between exercise and mental health.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha qilib aytganda, tadqiqot jismoniy mashqlar va ruhiy salomatlik o'rtasida kuchli bog'liqlikni aniqladi.

cards.ex: I'm drawing a blank, I can't remember the name of the scientist.
cards.exUz: Men eslay olmayapman, olimning ismini eslay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani eslay olmaslik yoki yechim topa olmaslik.

cards.ex: This discovery represents a major leap forward in our understanding of the disease.
cards.exUz: Bu kashfiyot kasallikni tushunishda katta sakrashni anglatadi.

cards.ex: It's just a matter of time before they find a cure.
cards.exUz: Ular davoni topishlari faqat vaqt masalasi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa muqarrar, faqat vaqt kerak.

cards.ex: Despite his success, the scientist remained down to earth and approachable.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatiga qaramay, olim oddiy va yaqin bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Amaliy va realistik nuqtai nazarga ega.

cards.ex: I need to hit the books, I have a big exam next week.
cards.exUz: Men o'qishga kirishim kerak, kelasi hafta katta imtihonim bor.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by assigning tasks.
cards.exUz: Keling, vazifalarni belgilash orqali ushbu loyihani ishga tushiramiz.

cards.ex: That lecture gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: O'sha ma'ruza menga o'ylash uchun ko'p narsa berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylantiradigan yoki mulohaza yuritishga undaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: The detectives left no stone unturned in their investigation.
cards.exUz: Detektivlar tergovda barcha imkoniyatni ishga solishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani sinab ko'rmoq, hech narsani qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: It was a shot in the dark, but it actually worked.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'r-ko'rona harakat edi, lekin u haqiqatan ham ish berdi.

cards.ex: The cause of the disease is still up for debate.
cards.exUz: Kasallikning sababi hali ham munozaraga ochiq.
cards.uzDef: Munozara qilinishi mumkin yoki bahsli bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The jury is still out on whether this new treatment is effective.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi davolash samarali ekanligi haqida hali aniq qaror qabul qilinmagan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida yakuniy qaror hali qabul qilinmagan.

cards.ex: We had to put that project on the back burner due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Mablag' etishmasligi sababli ushbu loyihani kechiktirishga majbur bo'ldik.

cards.ex: You should take his claims with a grain of salt, he's known to exaggerate.
cards.exUz: Uning da'volariga shubha bilan qarashingiz kerak, u mubolag'a qilishga moyil.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt

cards.ex: If one company invests in green technology, others will likely follow suit.
cards.exUz: Agar bir kompaniya yashil texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritsa, boshqalari ham namuna olishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Technology can be a double-edged sword; it can improve our lives but also create new problems.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilich bo'lishi mumkin; u hayotimizni yaxshilashi, ammo yangi muammolar yaratishi ham mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ham foydali, ham zararli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Many promising projects fall by the wayside due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina umidli loyihalar mablag' etishmasligi sababli chetga chiqib ketadi.

cards.ex: Finding a cure for that disease is a long shot, but we have to try.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kasallik uchun davo topish umidsiz urinish, lekin biz harakat qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Investing in renewable energy will be beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foydali bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Science often progresses through trial and error.
cards.exUz: Fan ko'pincha sinov va xato orqali rivojlanadi.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why the experiment failed.
cards.exUz: Biz tajriba nima uchun muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini aniqlashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: This problem is proving to be a tough nut to crack.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo yechish qiyin muammo bo'lib chiqmoqda.

cards.ex: The detective was able to connect the dots and solve the case.
cards.exUz: Detektiv ma'lumotlar o'rtasidagi aloqani topib, ishni hal qila oldi.
